briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 accelerate multi-agent capabilities amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration with o4 and R2 releases driving benchmark gains. AI investment remains robust while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with improved agent orchestration; DeepSeek releases R2 outperforming on coding evals; Meta's Llama 4.1 and xAI Grok-3 updates push context lengths. Anthropic Claude 4.5 focuses on constitutional alignment.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic workflows.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC 2nm production; Google TPU v6 clusters online in Iowa; Microsoft and CoreWeave expand 100k H100 equivalents. Power constraints delay multiple hyperscale builds.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve autonomous R&D loops before 2028 safety standards mature?
